pages.title: Raid prep

facts.value: what level to be for raiding: Blizzard lists all three raids as level 60 raids (raid overview)

world buffs do nothing inside a raid: Warchief's Blessing, Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer and Songflower Serenade say in their tooltips that they have no effect inside a raid instance, and Wowhead's Nov 13 news says world buffs work only in the open world and dungeons; the Alliance Might of Stormwind tooltip carried no such line when read on Nov 14 (Wowhead's Forever database, secondary)

which resistance raids need: fire resistance for Onyxia's Lair, which Blizzard says to build before entering; Blizzard says nothing about resistance for Barrow Deeps or Hyjal Summit, so that is known only from Dec 9. The Drakefire Amulet you carry for Onyxia gives +15 Fire Resistance (Wowhead tooltip)

fire consumables in the game: Greater Fire Protection Potion absorbs 1950 to 3250 fire damage for 2 minutes (level 48), and Flask of Chromatic Resistance gives +25 to every resistance for 2 hours (level 50) (Wowhead's Forever database tooltips, read Nov 14; secondary)

which flasks to use for raiding: the four Flasks of Natural (Accuracy, Aggression, Precision, Swiftness, level 55) give +30 Stamina anywhere, plus 2% hit, crit, haste or less chance to be dodged or parried only inside Mount Hyjal, Hyjal Summit and the Barrow Deeps; the Classic flasks are also in the game at level 50: Titans +1200 health, Supreme Power +150 spell damage, Distilled Wisdom +2000 mana. Each lasts 2 hours, one flask at a time, and persists through death (Wowhead's Forever database tooltips, read Nov 14; secondary)
class raid buffs last an hour and Shaman totem buffs reach the whole raid, so a group should not need to stack classes (the developers, in Wowhead's Nov 6 summary of a developer interview; secondary)

which raid drops the tier set: all three. The developers said the Tier 1 set is split across all three raids, so finishing a set takes all three, and a group that runs only the 10-player raid gets much of it but not all; which piece drops where is known only on Dec 9 (Wowhead's Nov 6 summary of a developer interview; secondary)

what loot the raids drop: known only once they open on Dec 9. No loot table was found in Blizzard posts or guides as of Nov 14; item stats stay hidden until an item drops for you or someone on your server, and there is no dungeon journal at first (Blizzard designer Josh Greenfield at BlizzCon, as reported by MMORPG.com and relayed by Warcraft Tavern on Sep 16; third-hand)

open: Resistance checks in Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit: Blizzard has said nothing; known only from Dec 9.
Tooltip values are Wowhead's Forever database as of Nov 14 and can change in a hotfix; recheck before Dec 9.
Might of Stormwind: its tooltip lacked the raid-instance line on Nov 14 while Wowhead's news says no world buff works in raids; confirm in game on Dec 9.
pages.blurb: Getting ready for the Dec 9 raids: level 60, the Drakefire Amulet for Onyxia, fire resistance for Onyxia, and flasks. World buffs do nothing inside raids. Barrow Deeps and Hyjal Summit resistance needs are unknown until they open.

history.text: Created from Blizzard's raid overview (re-read Nov 14), Wowhead's Forever tooltips (read Nov 14), Wowhead's Nov 6 interview summary and Nov 13 world-buff news, and Warcraft Tavern's Sep 16 Greenfield report. Link-only hosts are paraphrased, not quoted.
